ok.description: True when there are no errors. Warnings never fail the check.

pins.description: Pins, spacers left out; 0 when the module is not valid.

size.description: The drawn body in px, or null when the module is not valid.

warnings.description: Never fail the check. (There is no notes field: the generic-art note of earlier versions is now the custom-part-look warning.) custom-part-look: a part outside the library drawn as the generic box or with no photo; the gate blocks on it, so find the maker's product photo, draw its art per the art guide (references/art.md in the circuitoon-custom-part skill) and record the photo URL in photo. custom-part-no-photo: photo is "none"; the gate lists it as a warning.

code.description: duplicate-pin, invalid, type-caps, art-pins, caps-on-power, power-untyped, power-no-supply, ground-supply, supply-unknown, no-types, no-source, source-not-url, not-custom, long-name, firmware-custom, custom-part-look, custom-part-no-photo
